description: This Java source file defines the DefaultHiveMqtt5ClientFactory class, which implements a factory for creating MQTT 5 asynchronous clients using the HiveMQ client library. It provides singleton access and methods to configure new client instances with connection parameters, including optional connection listeners and logging.

classes.name: DefaultHiveMqtt5ClientFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class for creating configured MQTT 5 async clients, extending AbstractHiveMqttClientFactory and implementing HiveMqtt5ClientFactory.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of DefaultHiveMqtt5ClientFactory.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MQTT 5 async client with specified connection parameters, including optional connection listeners and a connection logger.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Configures and returns a builder for creating MQTT 5 clients, setting connection details, optional listeners, and authentication.
